senses.gloss: the covering of plants with rancid oil, or tying up with manure (v. זָהַם).
units: Ab. Zar. 50ᵇ ז׳ אוקומי וכ׳ ziham is a means of preserving the tree, v. ברי I ch.

senses.gloss: social disqualification, spot in the family record (not subject to legal disqualification).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:5:2">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לה אלא משום ז׳ כהונה וכ׳</he> there is nothing against her except a social disqualification for priesthood, but the court cannot declare her &c., v. <cite ref="G00102"><he>זָהַם</he></cite>; ib. XIII, 13ᵈ bot. <he>אין בה וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:8:2">Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אין בה משום ייחוס כהונה</he> (corr. acc.).
